div.div: Tier A — zero hardware. Neolix: 17,000+ vehicles, 160M+ km, RaaS SUBSCRIPTION. Zelos: 15,000 units, 300+ cities. We integrate with a service; we never buy a vehicle.

div.div:
THE DESIGN INSIGHT EVERYONE GETS WRONG
"Meituan's Beijing Shunyi model uses unmanned vehicles to move
parcels to TRANSFER STATIONS, with couriers completing the
last hundred metres."
Even the market leader runs a HYBRID.
A plan that assumes the robot completes the whole journey is
less credible than one that models the handoff —
and the handoff is where the software value is.

div.div:
Regulatory status is real, but PER CITY
2023 guidelines from four ministries incl. MIIT permit
L3/L4 pilot operation on public roads with
NATIONAL-LEVEL LEGAL STATUS.
Shenzhen, Shanghai, Hangzhou passed ordinances.
Beijing's pilot zone grew 160 → 600 km².
→ encode route availability as DATA, per city,
with an effective date.

HANDOFF PROTOCOL — the part nobody builds

div.div:
Market scale
China unmanned logistics → ¥263.4B by 2030, >40%/yr
Neolix #1 globally (Road to Autonomy, June 2026, 74.7 pts) — Meituan 6th
RoboSense took a 300,000-unit LiDAR order from Neolix
Meituan Keeta Drone: 70+ routes, 6 cities, 880,000+ deliveries by Mar 2026

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 253, 245), rgb(22, 20, 14)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1686px; height: 1px; padding-top: 610px; margin-left: 14px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Two rules that save a lot of grief
COD → exclude from robot methods by rule, or require prepayment. Robots handle cash badly. One line, big saving.
WEATHER → route-availability feed; fall back to human courier automatically. Never let a dispatch decision block on an external API.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(243, 250, 241), rgb(20, 26, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1686px; height: 1px; padding-top: 745px; margin-left: 14px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Line in the sand: choose the method, dispatch, track, handle the handoff. We do not own vehicles, routes or maintenance.
Measurement (I06 holdout by zone): COST PER DELIVERY by method · on-time rate · failed-pickup rate · method mix over time.
Steps 1–2 and 4 (9 days) are useful even if no robot vendor is ever signed — a fulfilment-method decision layer and a handoff state machine are worth having regardless.
